thread.title: Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) has appointed Nokia’s executive “Ashish Chowdhary” as new head of India operations

author: Jill King
title: Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) has appointed Nokia’s executive “Ashish Chowdhary” as new head of India operations
text:
November 14, 2018 Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) has appointed Nokia’s executive “Ashish Chowdhary” as new head of India operations
Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) has recently selected the Nokia’s executive “Ashish Chowdhary” as its new head of India operations, in a recent move of reorganization of Apple’s India executive team.
Ashish Chowdhary will join the Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s India team, in January of 2019. The news also aligns with a statement released today by Nokia Oyj (ADR) (NYSE:NOK) stating that the Chowdhary is leaving the Finnish company, by the end of 2018.
Nokia Oyj (ADR) (NYSE:NOK) said, “Chowdhary will continue to lead Customer Operations and remain a member of the Nokia Group Leadership Team until the end of 2018. He will then leave Nokia to take a leadership position in another company,”
Previously, Ashish Chowdhary has served at Nokia Networks in a role of as the Chief Customer Operations Officer, for the past 15 years. Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) hired him for its India’s team because of its in depth knowledge about the local smartphone and technology industry, that would strengthen Apple position in the market.
